subject: technology
topic: Predictive policing algorithms may reinforce systemic inequities through feedback loops
angle: While some models show a link between runaway feedback and crime rate disparities, a randomized controlled trial found no significant differences in racial arrest proportions during predictive policing deployments.
title: The Data of Policing

hooks.text: Does predictive policing actually create racial bias?
You assume feedback loops create bias. The data shows no significant difference in racial arrests.
You trust the algorithm to be neutral.
A blue light reflects off a wet sidewalk.

reveal.headline: Predictive policing does not show significant racial bias in arrests.
reveal.body: A randomized trial found no significant differences in the proportion of arrests by racial-ethnic group during these deployments.

explain.headline: The evidence on these tools is mixed.
explain.body: While runaway feedback loops are a theoretical risk, empirical data from a randomized trial did not show significant racial bias. Only 6 out of 161 reviewed articles were considered evidence-strong.

matters.headline: Technical fixes may mask deeper issues.
matters.body: Predictive policing for reform is often operationalized as a series of technical fixes that rely on the production of indeterminacies. That may be why the results are so difficult to interpret.

verdict: The evidence is mixed, showing that while runaway feedback loops are a theoretical and modeled risk, empirical data from a randomized trial did not show significant racial bias in arrests.
caveat: The evidence for the effectiveness of these tools is currently limited, with only 6 out of 161 reviewed articles being considered evidence-strong.
caption:
Predictive policing is designed to manage crime through data. 

Research shows mixed results. While feedback loops are a modeled risk, a randomized trial found no significant racial bias in arrests. However, the evidence for these tools is limited, with only 6 out of 161 reviewed articles considered evidence-strong.
